recipes.title: Blue Honey Immunity Marshmallows

items.i: Stardust Blue Immunity Powder, plus extra for dusting

steps: Grease a 20 cm square tin with coconut oil, line with baking paper and grease the paper.
Pour the cold water into a large heatproof bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over and leave 5–10 minutes until thick.
Warm the honey, water, vanilla and salt in a small saucepan (gently at first if the honey is crystallised), then bring to a full boil, about 100°C. Watch it, as honey foams up fast.
Pour the hot syrup over the gelatin and stir until fully melted and smooth.
Beat with electric beaters, low then high, about 5 minutes until pale, thick, glossy and tripled; it should fall in thick ribbons that hold briefly.
At the very end beat in the 3 tbsp Stardust powder until evenly blue.
Spread into the tin leaving soft swirls, dust with more Stardust and scatter bee pollen. Leave at room temperature at least 3 hours until set and springy.
Lift out and cut into 4–5 cm squares with an oiled knife, pressing straight down and re-oiling between cuts.
recipes.notes: Recipe is from Laura and Bren of Holist on the Part&Parcel blog; makes 20–24. Stardust Blue Immunity Powder is a blend of butterfly pea flower, blue spirulina, elderberry, ginger and astragalus. No nutrition is given, so the macros are my estimate for 22.
